cleanPlate: Complete recessed backing and fixed bearing stubs were generated before moving wheels. No duplicate moving wheel is baked into the five rotor wells.
masks: Cleaned PNG alpha follows tooth/spoke/axle silhouettes. Each rotor has a separate source-luminance highlight mask intersected with a small reflection footprint. Three fixed jewel/bearing masks localize pulse. Fixed axle caps and all unselected metal remain protected.
motion: Five rigid continuous spins share one fixed-step clock and a common user speed multiplier; adjacent large wheels counter-rotate. No texture deformation is applied to metal.

lighting.pulse: Three small selected bearing interiors, phase-staggered; no whole-frame or rotor pulse
lighting.glint: Bright source pixels only: sRGB luminance ramp .46.. .70 intersected with a local footprint. Warm specular color [1,.92,.72], intensity 3 within the unchanged intensity budget, linear luminance threshold .06, sharpness 3, staggered phases and an initial peak on the first rotor. Dark metal is unchanged; no exposure or contrast adjustment.

limitations: Artistic clockwork, not a CAD or contact-dynamics simulation
Only five separated rotors are animated; background microgears are stationary
Source resolution is recorded, not native 4K
No portal in this standalone studio scene
